Package ch.colabproject.colab.api.model.user

Class User

java.lang.Object
ch.colabproject.colab.api.model.user.User
All Implemented Interfaces:
ColabEntity, WithDeletionStatus, WithPermission, WithTrackingData, WithWebsocketChannels, WithId, WithJsonDiscriminator, Serializable
@Entity public class User extends Object implements ColabEntity, WithWebsocketChannels
Represents a registered user. A user may authenticate by several means (accounts).
